passive.name: Time In A Bottle
passive.description: Zilean stores time as Experience and can grant it to his allies. When he has enough Experience to finish an ally's level up, he can right-click them to impart it. Zilean receives as much Experience as he gives.

spells.name: Time Bomb
spells.description: Zilean tosses a time-delayed bomb that sticks to the first unit which comes within a small area around it. After seconds it detonates, dealing magic damage. Placing a second bomb on a unit that already has one detonates the first bomb immediately and Stuns enemies in the blast for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Rewind
spells.description: Zilean turns time, reducing his other basic Ability Cooldowns by seconds.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Time Warp
spells.description: Zilean Slows an enemy champion by % or grants an allied champion % Move Speed for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Chronoshift
spells.description: Zilean grants a protective time rune to an allied champion for seconds. If the target would die, the rune rewinds their timeline, putting them into Stasis for seconds, then reviving them and restoring Health.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.
